All three of these compounds share a common target, LAPC4, indicating a possible pathway where Ethyl 3-(methylthio)propionate may influence LAPC4 through its interaction with these intermediate targets. The scores from the different paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with varying degrees of support from each of the three compounds. The evidence is consistent across multiple paths, reinforcing the likelihood of a functional link between the compound and LAPC4. However, the strength of this relationship is not definitively established, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the biological relevance of this interaction.
